title: Culvert Road Crossing with Flared Drain Inlet
description: One static village drainage-road crossing scene, one scene and zero new independent models. One whole original stone box culvert road module and two whole original soil road grade modules follow the original three-piece arrangement with 2mm end gaps. One complete newly self-reviewed flared wing headwall meets the front lining mouth at the declared matching opening. All original mesh sets, oriented triangles and per-face opaque PBR values are retained at unit scale, with only exact 180-degree coordinate permutation, translations and collision-safe names. Seven meshes,426triangles,nine materials. Original culvert is one joined runtime mesh of touching closed parts and retains four canonical-weld nonmanifold edge diagnostics; it is not claimed to be a newly repaired single manifold body. No water, terrain insertion, hydraulic capacity, watertight soil installation, road safety, navigation, construction or engineering certification.
